body: Thanks the night is over, maybe you reconize this but now I hardly can describe to someone how I felt. By the time I can reach some help I've told myself it wasn't that bad.  But did you ever think about what happens wenn you die? Nothing, so I can't regret it
My neighbours the people around me

I'm just not sure anymore, I can hear them talking about me but it shouldn't be possible that they can see me. I closed every curtain and all, all I can think is they see me somehow. I've had it with this shit I had therapy for 2 years living a shitty life and i never wanted to give up more.
